Private excursion for Bleustein Family x 4.
Dec 27   ARRECIFE, LANZAROTE: The Norwegian Spirit docks in Arrecife, Lanzarote (at 8:00AM.

Description of the tour: See the most symbolic places Lanzarote has to offer on this full day tour. Discover Timanfaya National Park, its geothermal anomalies, and the panoramic Route of the Volcanoes. View the unusual volcanic landscape used to produce Lanzarote's local wines. Experience the masterpieces of the Cactus Garden and Jameos del Aqua, designed by César Manrique.
During this journey, you'll get to enjoy a variety of landscapes dotted across Lanzarote's geography, drive through villages of historic importance, learn about the culture of the island, and explore the curiosities making Lanzarote a unique destination..

Important information:
    Start of the tour: 9 am
    Meeting point with the guide: At the police control on the dock.
    Shore Excursion Duration: 7 Hours
    
We visit:
    Timanfaya National Park
    Jameos del Agua
    The Cactus Garden

It is included in the price:
    Air-conditioned transportation
    Local Guide Service
    Entrance to the Timanfaya National Park, , Jameos del Agua and the Cactus Garden
    Insurance 

The price does not include:
    Lunch
